name: daily-posts
description: Runs a daily posting loop where your answers stay the post: asks up to three questions about live debates with sources, saves your answers word for word, writes two drafts and a phrase list per answer, runs each draft through a voice-check editor, and schedules only drafts you approve by letter. Use when asked to "post every day with ai", "run my daily posts", "draft from my answers", or set up a morning-questions posting routine.
